candidates.source_name: Державна служба статистики України (Держстат) — статистика праці / зайнятість за видами економічної діяльності (КВЕД K: Фінансова та страхова діяльність)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated statistical authority publishing average headcount of staff (облікова кількість штатних працівників), average wages and labour turnover broken out by KVED section K 'Фінансова та страхова діяльність' — the only official, comparable time series for financial-sector employment and pay in Ukraine.
candidates.access_status: public, free; site frequently slow/unstable and some sections moved after 2022
candidates.legal_status: open government data (Law on Access to Public Information); reuse permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scheduled fetch of the labour-statistics express releases and XLS/PDF tables; parse KVED-K rows; fallback to regional GUS mirrors (e.g. ck.ukrstat.gov.ua) when the central site is down
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on statistical terminology (КВЕД / штатні працівники)
queries_used: Держстат зайнятість фінансова та страхова діяльність кількість штатних працівників

candidates.why_relevant: NBU supervisory statistics and the quarterly Banking Sector Review carry number of operating structural units (відділення) per bank and headcount indicators for the banking system — the core quantitative feed for branch-network contraction and staffing changes.
candidates.access_status: public, free; PDF + XLSX data files
candidates.legal_status: open public data, reuse with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled download of the periodic Banking Sector Review PDF and the supervisory statistics XLSX packs; extract branch counts and staff-related tables
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from press coverage citing NBU branch/headcount data
queries_used: НБУ статистика кількість працівників банків структурні підрозділи банків дані наглядова статистика

candidates.source_name: НБУ — новини та рішення про погодження керівників банків (fit & proper approvals)
candidates.why_relevant: Under Art.42 of the Law on Banks and Banking Activity, chairs/board members/chief accountants/supervisory board members can only take office after NBU approval. NBU communications and decisions are therefore the authoritative primary trigger for every senior leadership move in UA banking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the NBU news feed and Board-decision register, filter on 'погодження', 'керівник банку', 'голова правління'
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles: who must approve leadership changes

candidates.why_relevant: NBU resolutions define the criteria and algorithm by which banks and non-bank financial institutions obtain 'critically important enterprise' status and defer staff from mobilisation — the single most UA-specific driver of bank staffing capacity during wartime.

negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-specific banking/financial-services salary guide from a global recruiter (Hays, Michael Page, Robert Walters, Korn Ferry) was located. Hays publishes salary guides for the US/Canada/UK and Michael Page for banking & financial services in other markets, but searches surfaced no Ukraine edition.
negative_findings.result_summary: Global recruiter salary guides exist but appear not to cover Ukraine; UA comp benchmarking seems to be served by local agencies, EBA member surveys and derived media analyses instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means there is no off-the-shelf international benchmark for UA banking pay; comp intelligence must be assembled from Держстат KVED-K wages, NBU personnel-expense data and EBA/local agency surveys.

negative_findings.description: The Independent Association of Banks of Ukraine (НАБУ) was checked for an HR/personnel committee. Its published committee list covers taxation & accounting, regulatory policy & compliance, and legal/creditor-rights matters only.
negative_findings.result_summary: No HR or workforce committee found at the main banking association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: There is no sector-level bank HR body producing aggregate workforce statistics, so bank staffing intelligence has to come from the regulator, statistics office and commercial recruiters rather than an industry HR forum.

negative_findings.description: ANCOR, named in the cell brief as a recruiter, has its principal web presence and salary-survey product on ancor.ru, a Russia-domiciled group site; only a Ukrainian agency profile page was found via work.ua.
negative_findings.result_summary: ANCOR's Ukraine-specific salary-survey output could not be confirmed as independently published from a Ukrainian entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Procuring or citing RU-linked workforce research for a Ukraine banking study carries sanctions, data-integrity and reputational risk; it should be screened or substituted.

negative_findings.description: No public dataset was found that reports headcount per individual Ukrainian bank on a recurring basis. Media report system-level and occasionally single-bank figures (e.g. PrivatBank ~19.8k) sourced from NBU/statement disclosures, but not a maintained per-bank series.
negative_findings.result_summary: Per-bank headcount must be reconstructed from bank annual reports/financial statements rather than a ready-made regulator series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any per-institution workforce tracking will require statement-level extraction, which is slower and less frequent than branch-count tracking.

negative_findings.description: Searches in Ukrainian on branch closures plus mobilisation returned abundant material on branch-network contraction but essentially nothing quantifying how many bank employees have been mobilised, deferred (заброньовані) or relocated.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mobilisation impact on bank staffing is described qualitatively and regulated procedurally, but not measured publicly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most distinctive UA workforce driver is the least quantified; estimates will need proxies (deferment-quota rules, vacancy mix, personnel expense) or primary interviews.

coverage_gaps.description: Exact deep-link paths for Держстат labour-statistics tables filtered to KVED section K, and for the NBU supervisory statistics files containing staff headcount, were not pinned down within this pass; only the portal roots and example artefacts are recorded.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated crawl of ukrstat.gov.ua labour-statistics and bank.gov.ua/ua/statistic file indexes to capture stable file URLs and update frequencies; treat any 403/timeout as bot-defence, not death.

coverage_gaps.description: Ukrainian HR professional communities and HR-media (e.g. HR-associations, HR conferences, HR-focused media) were not systematically enumerated; no Ukrainian HR-professional body was confirmed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search terms such as 'Асоціація HR-фахівців України', 'HR Pro', 'HR-спільнота', 'HR-форум банки' and check LinkedIn groups; these bodies often publish practitioner salary and turnover snapshots.

coverage_gaps.description: Relocation and diaspora-employment angle (UA bank staff working from Poland/Germany, remote hubs, return intentions) is not yet covered by any source in this slice beyond generic KSE migration research.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add IOM Ukraine, UNHCR, NBU migration surveys and Polish/EU labour-registry statistics on Ukrainian financial-sector workers as a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: The most decision-useful comp data (EBA full salary survey, recruiter benchmarks, FinClub full texts, Opendatabot API) sits behind paid or membership access, and job-board terms of service may restrict automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope a licensing/budget decision early: EBA membership or survey purchase, an Opendatabot API key, and a legal review of work.ua/robota.ua ToS before any scraping is built.

coverage_gaps.description: Almost all substantive workforce material for UA financial services exists only in Ukrainian; English coverage is thin and second-hand (Interfax-Ukraine, occasional Forbes/NV English items).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Ukrainian-language extraction and translation in the collection pipeline; do not staff this cell with English-only collection.

brief: Workforce intelligence on Ukrainian financial services rests on a narrow but solid official base — Держстат for KVED-K employment and wages, NBU for branch-network counts, system headcount and every senior-appointment approval under Art.42, and the State Employment Service for monthly vacancy/unemployment trends. Around it sits a commercial and media layer: job boards (Work.ua, robota.ua) as near-real-time hiring proxies, EBA and KSE Institute for employer-side surveys and human-capital research, recruiters (Brain Source, ANCOR — the latter RU-linked and needing screening) selling comp benchmarks, and Forbes Ukraine / FinClub / FINBALANCE / NV as the practical event feed for leadership moves, branch closures and mobilisation-deferment rules. The distinctly Ukrainian drivers — mobilisation, staff deferment (бронювання) and relocation — are well regulated and widely narrated but almost entirely unquantified in public sources, and no maintained per-bank headcount series exists. Collection should therefore be Ukrainian-language-first, anchored on the two state datasets, with the paid layer (EBA survey, Opendatabot API, FinClub) treated as a deliberate licensing decision rather than a scraping target.
